consoleText:
Illustration of built-in list operations

List multiplication with [0]*8:
[0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

Assignment of values to elements - square of index:
[0, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49]

APPEND element valued 64 to the list:
[0, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64]

DELETE element at index 3 from the list:
[0, 1, 4, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64]

EXTEND list with [81,100]:
[0, 1, 4, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100]

REMOVE element valued 16:
[0, 1, 4, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100]

Identify INDEX of element valued 36:
Index of 36 = 4

INSERT element valued 16 at index 5:
[0, 1, 4, 25, 36, 16, 49, 64, 81, 100]

REVERSE list:
[100, 81, 64, 49, 16, 36, 25, 4, 1, 0]

Iterate through list elements:
100  81  64  49  16  36  25  4  1  0  

Print every third element:
64  36  1
